```python
import pandas as pd
import zipfile, requests, io

# Load main data
main = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

# Load metadata to identify aggregates/countries
url = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/en/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS?downloadformat=csv"
resp = requests.get(url)
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(resp.content)) as z:
    meta_country = [f for f in z.namelist() if f.startswith('Metadata_Country_API_NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS_DS2_en_csv_v2')][0]
    mc = pd.read_csv(z.open(meta_country))

# Join to tag aggregates
mc = mc.rename(columns={'Table Name': 'Country Name'})
joined = main.merge(mc[['Country Name', 'Region']], on='Country Name', how='left')

# Qualify function and filter to countries (Region not 'Aggregates')
def qualifies(row):
    vals = row[years]
    return vals.notnull().all() and (vals > 35).all()

candidate = joined[joined.apply(qualifies, axis=1)]
country_only = candidate[joined['Region'] != 'Aggregates']['Country Name']
print(', '.join(sorted(country_only)))
```
